TOP RIGHT DOWNED kneeling, helm bowed, shield resting upright close, mace low, desaturate40%. BOTTOM LEFT ATTACK SHIELD BASH toward SCREEN RIGHT, left shield extended forward +X, right mace tucked by hip, compact stance.
